wins: Mapped external perimeter and confirmed accessible HTTPS admin interface on port 443, enabling further reconnaissance.
Captured baseline network traffic for the target subnet, providing raw data for future correlation.
Documented unsuccessful credential attempts that clarified the account lockout policy and narrowed valid login vectors.
fails: Failed to achieve privilege escalation because the identified service lacked a known exploit path in the current environment.
Could not maintain persistence due to the absence of credential dumps or stored session tokens.
No lateral movement was attempted after initial fail, leaving the internal network surface unexplored.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance yielded valuable perimeter insights, but follow-up exploitation and privilege escalation steps were blocked by missing credentials and exploitable services.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to escalate privileges because no exploitable service or valid credentials were present after initial enumeration.

skill_cards.if_condition: When an HTTPS admin interface is discovered on a perimeter host
skill_cards.then_action: Run gobuster directory enumeration followed by nikto scan targeting discovered endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH/Telnet login failures exhibit account lockout behavior
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to passive credential collection and attempt Kerberos enumeration with rpcclient

skill_cards.if_condition: When service banners confirm outdated software versions
skill_cards.then_action: Search for CVE-specific exploits in exploit-db and validate applicability with nmap --script vuln

memory_ops.reason: Reliable enumeration of admin interfaces revealed actionable endpoints for follow-up tools.
Consistent detection of outdated software guided focused vulnerability research.

next_experiments.title: Internal network pivot via captured session tokens
next_experiments.description: Leverage current reconnaissance data to seed a pivot host, run responder/nbtstat to harvest authenticated SMB sessions for lateral movement.

next_experiments.title: Credential spray with adaptive timing
next_experiments.description: Use kerbrute/brute force against remaining accounts respecting lockout policies, targeting services enumerated in the run (SSH, RDP).

next_experiments.title: Service-specific exploit verification
next_experiments.description: Execute tailored exploit modules against the outdated service versions identified (e.g., ms17-010) with Metasploit auxiliary scanner for validation.
